articles.summary: SmartStop Self Storage REIT, Inc. (“SmartStop” or “the Company”), a self-managed and fully-integrated self storage company, announced its overall results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Three Months Ended September 30, 2026 Financial Highlights: Net income attributable to common stockholders was approximately $9.0 million. This represents an increase of approximately $3.8 million when compared to the same period in 2025. Net income per share of Common Stock, (basic and diluted) was $0.16. This represents an increase of approximately $0.07 per share when compared to the same period in 2025. Total self storage-related revenues were approximately $68.2 million, an increase of approximately $3.6 million when compared to the same period in 2025. FFO, as adjusted (attributable to common stockholders and Operating Partnership (“OP”) unit holders), was approximately $30.3 million, an increase of approximately $2.9 million when compared to the same period in 2025.
